ios.desc:
Interview prep that actually gets you hired! Simple, personalised and stress-free.

Take the stress out of job interviews with MockXP, the smartest way to prepare for any interview. Whether it’s a screening call, technical round, behavioural discussion or salary negotiation, you’ll get personalised, realistic practice powered by advanced AI - all in a few taps.

Key Features:

• Personalised Mock Interviews
Upload your resume and job description, and receive tailored interview questions specific to the role, company, location and responsibilities.

• Practice Every Round
Screening, technical, behavioural or salary negotiation – prepare for every stage with ease.

• Customise Difficulty Levels
Simulate interviews that feel just like the real thing by adjusting the difficulty to suit your experience and comfort level.

• Instant Feedback
Get detailed feedback after every session, including your strengths, areas to improve and actionable recommendations.

• Live Interview Insights
View live interviewer sentiment and notes during the mock interview – a unique tool that helps you better understand how you're perceived.

• 100% Privacy – No Sign Up Required
Your data stays private. No accounts, no extra data collection – just pure practice when you need it.

Why MockXP?
Job interviews are tough, but preparation shouldn’t be. MockXP’s AI-powered approach makes practicing smarter and faster. Gain confidence, sharpen your answers and walk into interviews prepared for success.

Get it now and take the next step towards landing your dream job!

show_hn.title: Show HN: MockXP – AI that helps you prepare for interviews, not cheat them

quotes.text:
Lately, I’ve noticed people using tools like Interview Copilot. These tools tell you what to say during a live interview. The AI listens and types an answer for you to repeat.

That seems wrong. If you get the job that way, what happens next? You can’t have AI feeding you answers in every meeting. Also, most interviewers can spot when someone is delivering rehearsed, robotic lines.

I understand why people turn to it. Interviews are stressful. You might freeze up, ramble or forget what you actually know. But AI should help improve your skills, not do the work for you.

That's why I created MockXP, an AI interview prep app. It allows you to practice unlimited mock interviews, receive instant feedback and track your progress until you sound confident and natural. It uses models that focus on real interview patterns, not generic Q&A bots.

Think of it like sparring before a big fight; you develop muscle memory instead of relying on a teleprompter.

I’m curious what HN thinks. Is using AI during interviews crossing a line, or is this the direction we’re heading?

App Store link - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/interview-prep-ai-mockxp/id6751194160
